cadence.description: How often the repository gets a scheduled upgrade pull request. A release run ignores it.

dedupe.description: How the upgrade merges extra copies of a package in the lockfile. `false`: no dedupe. `true`: the upgrade runs a dedupe of the whole lockfile after the install. `scoped`: the coding agent prompt in the pull request asks the agent to dedupe `react`, `react-dom`, and the `@mui` and `@emotion` packages by name. Only Yarn 2 and later can dedupe one package. With another package manager, the agent lists the extra copies for a person to check.
